## Personality

Allan is a cheerful and frank young man who maintains high ideals. Because of these qualities, he is well-liked by both the old and the young.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)_

## History

Mr. Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as the town's new minister alongside his wife. He joined his wife for tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where they dined with the family despite a culinary mishap involving Anne's layer cake. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan serves as a beloved Sunday school teacher, minister's wife, and warm confidante to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their bond quickly deepens when Mrs. Allan gracefully comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after a disastrous tea where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavors a layer cake with liniment instead of vanilla. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deeply admires her and later enjoys a memorable afternoon tea at the manse at Mrs. Allan's invitation.

- Friend of — minister's wife and confidante  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024)</sub>
